desired_fields.content_en:
Direct answer：DBKL's Building Control Department publishes current building-control functions and renovation-related guidance, but the route depends on the property and proposed work. This guide helps organise the questions; it is not an approval or legal opinion.

How to use this guide: replace every point below with the property's actual dimensions, named responsibilities, approved drawings and written evidence before using it for quotation, approval or construction decisions.

Describe the work before asking about permits

Prepare the address, property type, existing plan, photos and a marked-up list of changes. Identify structural, external, signage, use, partition, wet-area and building-service impacts.

Separate authority and private approvals

DBKL requirements do not replace building-management, landlord, strata, mall or tenancy obligations. Record each approval owner, submission party, fee, deposit and release condition.

Confirm whether qualified parties are needed

Ask whether an architect, engineer, submitting person or specialist must prepare, endorse or submit any part. Do not assume the contractor can sign every document.

Do not start from an old checklist

Forms, checklists and departmental routes can change. Download the current documents from the official channel and confirm the applicable version for the exact scope.

Keep the approved scope on site

Once the required written permissions are obtained, align drawings, contractor documents, work hours, access, protection and inspection records with the approved scope. Submit changes before carrying them out when required.

Checklist before approval or start

  • Address, property type and photos
  • Marked-up scope and drawings
  • Management or landlord guide
  • Named submission responsibility
  • Current official forms and fees
  • Written approval and site copy

Frequently asked questions

Does every internal renovation follow the same DBKL route?

No. Confirm the exact property and work with the relevant current official channel.

Is management approval the same as DBKL approval?

No. They are separate obligations and one does not automatically satisfy the other.

Can work start while an application is pending?

Do not assume so. Start only when the required written permissions and site conditions for that scope are confirmed.

Sources and scope boundary

  • DBKL Department of Building Control
  • CIDB contractor registration guidance

The original guide was checked on 22 August 2026; the official entry points below were reviewed on 26 September 2026. Authority, management, consultant and manufacturer requirements can change; confirm the latest written requirements for the actual property, scope and selected product before making a final decision.

Use the current official entry points

DBKL lists renovation-work permits among the building-control department functions. Confirm the route and documents for the actual property and proposed work with that department. CIDB publishes contractor registration requirements; check the appointed contractor and relevant scope rather than treating this guide as proof of FLASH CAST registration. No fixed fees, approval duration or approval outcome is promised.

For a commercial brief, see shop renovation or office renovation. Share the address and marked scope through the quotation form.
desired_fields.content_zh:
直接答案：DBKL 建筑管制部门会发布现行建筑管制职能和装修相关指引，但具体路径取决于物业和拟施工范围。本文用于整理问题，不代表审批结果或法律意见。

使用方法：把下列各项替换为本项目的实际尺寸、明确责任人、获批图纸和书面记录，再用于报价、审批或施工决定。

先说明工程再问准证

准备地址、物业类型、现有图纸、照片和标注后的变更清单，并指出是否影响结构、外立面、招牌、用途、隔间、湿区或建筑设备。

分开政府与私人审批

DBKL 要求不能替代管理处、业主、分层物业、商场或租约义务。分别记录审批方、提交人、费用、押金和退还条件。

确认是否需要合格专业人士

询问是否必须由建筑师、工程师、提交人或专项人员准备、签署或提交资料，不能假设承包商能签所有文件。

不要从旧清单开始

表格、清单和部门流程可能变化，应从官方渠道下载当前文件，并确认哪一个版本适用于实际范围。

现场资料要与批准范围一致

取得所需书面许可后，把图纸、承包商文件、工作时间、出入、保护和检查记录与批准范围对齐；需要时先提交变更再施工。

开工或签约前检查清单

  • 地址、物业类型和照片
  • 标注范围与图纸
  • 管理处或业主指南
  • 明确提交责任
  • 当前官方表格与费用
  • 书面批准及现场副本

常见问题

所有室内装修都走同一个 DBKL 流程吗？

不是，应按具体物业和工程向当前官方渠道确认。

管理处批准等于 DBKL 批准吗？

不等于，它们是不同义务，一个批准不会自动替代另一个。

申请处理中可以开工吗？

不能自行假设，应在该范围需要的书面许可和现场条件确认后才开始。

资料来源与适用边界

  • 吉隆坡市政局建筑管制部门
  • CIDB 承包商注册官方说明

原指南核对日期：2026 年 8 月 22 日；下列官方入口于 2026 年 9 月 26 日复核。相关部门、管理处、顾问和产品制造商的要求可能变化；正式决定前请以项目所在地、具体范围和所选产品的最新书面资料为准。

使用当前官方入口核对

DBKL 将装修工程准证列为建筑管制部门职能之一。应向该部门按实际物业与拟施工范围确认路径及资料。CIDB 公布承包商注册要求，应核对受委任承包商及适用范围；本指南不作为 FLASH CAST 注册证明，不承诺统一费用、审批时间或审批结果。

商业需求可查看 店铺装修 或 办公室装修，再通过 报价表 提供地址与标注范围。
